content:
From \(f(t)=f(2-t)\), setting \(t=2\) gives
\[
f(2)=f(0)=0
\]
since \(f\) is odd.

Also \(f(t+2)=-f(t)\), so \(f\) has period \(4\), and each block of four consecutive values sums to \(0\):
\[
f(1)+f(2)+f(3)+f(4)=f(1)+f(2)-f(1)-f(2)=0.
\]
Thus
\[
\sum_{k=1}^{22} f(k)=f(21)+f(22)=f(1)+f(2)=f(1).
\]
Given this sum is \(1\), we have \(f(1)=1\). Since \(\ln e=1\),
\[
\boxed{1}
\]
